title: Canonical affine algebra homology comparison as a counit mate
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism, and write $R=g_*$ for its direct-image-algebra module functor. Let $P\dashv R$ be an additive exact left adjoint. For a cochain complex $I$ and $n\in\mathbf Z$, define $m_{I,n}:H^n(RI)\to R(H^n(I))$ to be the adjoint mate under $P\dashv R$ of $H^n(\epsilon_I)\circ c_{RI}^{-1}$, where $c$ is the exact-functor homology comparison and $\epsilon_I$ is the termwise counit. The objects and operations are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category], [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image], [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], [def-pur-kinjective-complex], [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [lem-weil-pbc-termwise-adjunction-homotopy], [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below].

def affineAlgebraCounitHomologyComparison
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [P.Additive] [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P] [Limits.PreservesFiniteColimits P]
    (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (n : ℤ) :
    (((RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage
      (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj I).homology n ⟶
      (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj (I.homology n)
